summary.text: Allen Caruso is the Republican, Conservative Party and Vote Affordable Party candidate for New York State Assembly District 113 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Carrie Woerner (Democratic) and Thomas Kenny (Working Families Party / No Kings Party).

paragraphs.text: Ballotpedia also lists Allen Caruso among the withdrawn or disqualified candidates in the 2026 Republican primary for New York's 21st Congressional District.
